notes: Camera-side connectors for control, audio, and power are physically combined into a single locking Hirose 12-pin "I/O" port on the camera body, which breaks out via an included breakaway cable into separate RS-485, stereo audio (TRS), and 12VDC power (DC barrel) leads; these are listed as separate logical ports above per the port-extraction convention, using the breakout cable's connector types since that is what a user actually plugs into. Exact TRS audio jack size and HDMI version number are not stated by Marshall and are not confirmed elsewhere; HDMI grade omitted rather than guessed. Product is discontinued per marshall-usa.com but the official spec sheet remains the authoritative source used. No rack mounting - miniature point-of-view camera body (approx 44 x 47 x 40mm) with universal 1/4-20" mount and interchangeable M12 lens mount.

ports.name: 3G-SDI
ports.note: Full-size BNC, 3G/HDSDI output; stereo audio embedded on this output

ports.name: HDMI
ports.note: Full-size HDMI output, simultaneous with SDI; HDMI version not stated by manufacturer

ports.name: I/O (RS-485 Remote Control)
ports.note: Broken out from the locking Hirose I/O breakaway cable; used for VISCA/RS-485 remote camera control

ports.name: I/O (Stereo Audio Input)
ports.note: Broken out from the locking Hirose I/O breakaway cable; mic/line stereo audio input, embedded onto the 3G-SDI output. Exact jack size (3.5mm vs 6.35mm) inferred, not explicitly stated on the spec sheet.

ports.name: SERVICE
ports.note: Field-serviceable firmware update port, micro-USB style connector shown on rear panel

ports.name: 12VDC Power Input
ports.note: Broken out from the locking Hirose I/O breakaway cable; 12VDC +/-10%, ~6W draw, center-positive 2.1mm barrel plug on included power supply
